_comment: Drives the coverage assertion in assert.mjs. skipped_ok = test_ids that are LEGITIMATELY SKIPPED even on an authenticated headless run (interactive login/OTP, browser-only client checks, or out-of-band like SSRF callback). Any SKIPPED test NOT in this list fails the harness. must_run_authed = tests that MUST actually execute (status not SKIPPED) when a token is configured — this is the proof that the authenticated-scan path works end-to-end.

skipped_ok_reasons.AUTH-03: client-side token storage — needs a real browser
skipped_ok_reasons.AUTH-05: session fixation — needs the live login flow (pre/post-login session id)
skipped_ok_reasons.API-05: still hardcoded-skip in the pipeline (auth-session) — future auth-upgrade candidate
skipped_ok_reasons.API-06: still hardcoded-skip in the pipeline (auth-session) — future auth-upgrade candidate
skipped_ok_reasons.SSRF-03: blind SSRF needs an out-of-band collaborator server
skipped_ok_reasons.XVAL-01..11: cross-validation correlates SAST findings against live endpoints — the deterministic headless path skips it (no live correlation step wired)

_expected_blocked_comment: No expected hard-blocks against the current released Kali image (v1.1.0 ships checkov in a venv + gitleaks on PATH). Any BLOCK now = a NEW regression (a backing tool went missing) and fails the harness. Exit-code cases (whatweb/fuzz_api/xsstrike) are warnings, not blocks.
